product_wide_rationale: The exemption changes Product-wide concurrency admission for Concord's own workflow repair, so no child Domain can define or widen it independently.
summary: A signed operator-approved successor contract can classify Concord workflow repair with a typed refusal, blocked operation, and evidence references. The classification bypasses only Domain-overlap admission, keeps overlaps visible, and gives no exemption to ordinary work.
title: Operator-approved self-repair bypasses overlap admission
